_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_PDF/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_PDF/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Written 2026-10-10 from Docs_UNI_SIM/store-listings/universal-pdf.md (Data safety, checked against the code 2026-09-14): opening, filling, signing, marking up and converting a PDF happen on the device and collect nothing; sign-in (@unisim/sdk) is optional (password, emailed code, or Apple/Google/Microsoft); Send to sign uploads the PDF and the signer's email. Sending a document to a signer is a transfer the user starts, not sharing. The suite user count (@unisim/sdk presence.js) is OFF in the phone app since 2026-10-12 (src/main.tsx `presence: !isNativeShell()`; Play and App Store figures count installs), so no Device or other IDs. App interactions stay, optional: one session.opened event per launch while signed in (<UsageTracker />), for Analytics. Re-import this at the next Play release. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
